death.attack.dark.player: %1$s was defeated with darkness while fighting %1$s
klyntars.voice.legame_primo.2: Warm. Loud. Alive. We choose you, %s.
klyntars.voice.legame_primo.3: Do not scream. We are not leaving. We are home.
klyntars.voice.legame_primo.4: There is no more you, %s. Only us.
klyntars.voice.trasformazione.1: Let us out. We have been patient.
klyntars.voice.trasformazione.2: Skin is overrated. Wear us instead.
klyntars.voice.trasformazione.4: Stand up straight, %s. They should see us coming.
klyntars.voice.trasformazione.5: Teeth out. Now we can play.
klyntars.voice.ritorno.1: Fine. We will be quiet. For now.
klyntars.voice.ritorno.2: Back inside. It is cramped in here, %s.
klyntars.voice.ritorno.3: Hiding us again? We were having fun.
klyntars.voice.ritorno.4: Put us away, then. We will remember this.
klyntars.voice.bond2.1: We are learning your shape, %s. We like it.
klyntars.voice.bond2.2: Stronger together. Did you feel that?
klyntars.voice.bond2.3: Your heart and ours beat on the same drum now.
klyntars.voice.bond3.1: No more holding back. Everything we are is yours.
klyntars.voice.bond3.2: We fit perfectly now, %s. Like we were always here.
klyntars.voice.bond3.3: Listen. That is not your heartbeat anymore. It is ours.
klyntars.voice.fame_50.2: Something with a heartbeat would be nice. Soon.
klyntars.voice.fame_50.3: Feed us and we stay polite. That is the deal.
klyntars.voice.fame_50.4: Is that a chicken? We are only asking.
klyntars.voice.fame_25.1: Hungry. Very hungry. Find us something that bleeds.
klyntars.voice.fame_25.2: We are not joking now, %s. Food.
klyntars.voice.fame_25.3: Chocolate would help. So would a zombie.
klyntars.voice.fame_25.4: Every creature out there smells like dinner.
klyntars.voice.fame_10.1: FEED US. Or we feed ourselves.
klyntars.voice.fame_10.4: Our patience is as empty as our stomach.
klyntars.voice.berserk_inizio.2: You had your chance, %s. Now we hunt.
klyntars.voice.berserk_fine.1: ...Better. Much better. Sorry about the mess.
klyntars.voice.berserk_fine.2: Full. You can have the wheel back, %s.
klyntars.voice.berserk_fine.3: Do not look at us like that. You were not feeding us.
klyntars.voice.pasto.5: Not as good as chocolate. Still, not bad.
klyntars.voice.scottatura.1: HOT! Get us away from that!
klyntars.voice.scottatura.2: Fire, %s! Fire is not our friend!
klyntars.voice.scottatura.3: We felt that. We did not like it.
klyntars.voice.scottatura.4: Burning is a no. A very big no.
klyntars.voice.indebolito.1: Too much heat... we cannot hold our shape.
klyntars.voice.indebolito.2: It hurts, %s. Let us hide inside you.
klyntars.voice.indebolito.3: We are weak... keep us away from the flames.
klyntars.voice.indebolito.4: Everything is spinning. Give us time.
klyntars.voice.colpo_sonoro.3: Sound... it tears at us. Get us away from it.
klyntars.voice.colpo_sonoro_ultimo.1: One more of those and we are gone, %s. Please.
klyntars.voice.colpo_sonoro_ultimo.2: We cannot hold on through another one!
klyntars.voice.colpo_sonoro_ultimo.3: If that sound comes again, it rips us out of you.
klyntars.voice.strappato.1: %s! Do not let them take us—
klyntars.voice.strappato.3: We will find you again, %s. We always do.
klyntars.voice.salute_bassa.2: Do not die. We just got comfortable.
klyntars.voice.salute_bassa.3: Your heart is slowing down. We do not like that.
klyntars.voice.salute_bassa.4: Get us out of here. We will patch you up later.
klyntars.voice.uccisione.3: Can we eat it? We are asking nicely.
klyntars.voice.uccisione.4: Good. Now find a bigger one.
klyntars.voice.ragno.1: Eight legs... now we crawl like it did. Interesting.
klyntars.voice.ragno.2: We learned something from that spider, %s.
klyntars.voice.ragno.3: Walls, ceilings... the whole world is a floor now.
klyntars.voice.knull.1: That voice... the King in Black. We remember him.
klyntars.voice.knull.2: Something old woke up in us, %s. Something with wings.
klyntars.voice.knull.3: The god of the abyss touched us. The sky is ours now.
klyntars.voice.invisibile.1: Now you see us. Now you do not.
klyntars.voice.invisibile.3: Nobody looks at the dark, %s. That is our advantage.
klyntars.voice.cur_warden.1: That thing... it screams through walls. Do not wake it.
klyntars.voice.cur_warden.2: Quiet, %s. One roar from that and we burn from the inside.
klyntars.voice.cur_warden.3: Run. That is not a fight we can win.
klyntars.voice.cur_campana.1: A bell. Do not ring it, %s. Please.
klyntars.voice.cur_campana.2: We hate those. One ring and we shake apart.
klyntars.voice.cur_campana.3: Keep away from the singing metal.
klyntars.voice.cur_fuoco.1: Fire. Walk around it, not through it.
klyntars.voice.cur_fuoco.2: Heat ahead. We do not like heat.
klyntars.voice.cur_fuoco.3: Careful, %s. That fire wants to eat us.
klyntars.voice.cur_ragno.1: A spider... we could learn a lot from how it tastes.
klyntars.voice.cur_ragno.2: Feed that one to us, %s. We want its legs. Its tricks.
klyntars.voice.cur_ragno.3: Eight legs. Walls. Ceilings. We want that.
klyntars.voice.cur_simbionte.1: Another one of us... we can smell it.
klyntars.voice.cur_simbionte.2: A lonely symbiote nearby. Looking for a host.
klyntars.voice.cur_simbionte.3: Careful. That one is not ours.
klyntars.voice.cur_ospite.1: That one is wearing a symbiote. We can smell it.
klyntars.voice.cur_ospite.3: Family. The kind you never turn your back on.
klyntars.voice.cur_villaggio.1: So many soft little heads. We will behave. Probably.
klyntars.voice.cur_villaggio.2: Villagers. They look delicious. We are joking. Mostly.
klyntars.voice.cur_villaggio.3: Be nice, %s. They sell things. We think.
klyntars.voice.cur_notte.2: The dark is ours, %s. Let us hunt.
klyntars.voice.cur_notte.3: Everything is scared at night. Except us.
klyntars.voice.cur_buio.1: Pitch black. Good. We can see. They cannot.
klyntars.voice.cur_buio.2: We like it down here. Quiet. Cold. Ours.
klyntars.voice.cur_buio.3: No light at all. Finally, somewhere comfortable.
klyntars.voice.umore_felice.1: We like this, %s. You and us.
klyntars.voice.umore_felice.2: Good host. Good food. Good day.
klyntars.voice.umore_felice.3: We could get used to this.
klyntars.voice.umore_felice.4: Admit it. You like having us around.
klyntars.voice.umore_neutro.1: Bored. Find us something to do.
klyntars.voice.umore_neutro.3: Are we going somewhere, or just walking?
klyntars.voice.umore_irritato.1: You starve us, you burn us... and you want our help?
klyntars.voice.umore_irritato.3: Keep this up and we stop listening.
klyntars.voice.umore_irritato.4: We remember everything you do to us.
klyntars.voice.des_caccia_chiede.1: The night smells of prey. Hunt something for us, %s.
klyntars.voice.des_caccia_chiede.2: We want a hunt. In the dark. Tonight.
klyntars.voice.des_caccia_fatto.2: Yes. That is how it is done.
klyntars.voice.des_caccia_fallito.1: No hunt? We will remember that.
klyntars.voice.des_carne_chiede.2: We want something that used to moo. Or oink. Anything.
klyntars.voice.des_carne_fatto.2: Meat. Finally. We like you again.
klyntars.voice.des_carne_fallito.1: You forgot to feed us. Again.
klyntars.voice.des_carne_fallito.2: No meat. We are sulking now.
klyntars.voice.des_altezza_chiede.1: Take us up high. We want to see everything.
klyntars.voice.des_altezza_chiede.2: Climb, %s. We want the sky under our feet.
klyntars.voice.des_profondita_chiede.1: Down. Deep down, where it is dark and quiet.
klyntars.voice.des_profondita_fatto.2: Yes. We could stay down here forever.
klyntars.voice.des_profondita_fallito.2: We asked for the dark. You gave us nothing.
klyntars.voice.des_scontro_chiede.1: We want a fight. Three of them. Now.
klyntars.voice.des_scontro_chiede.2: Find us some enemies, %s. At least three.
klyntars.voice.des_scontro_fallito.2: No fights? We are withering in here.
klyntars.voice.broncio.1: No. Fight on your own for a while.
klyntars.voice.broncio.2: We are not helping. Not after that.
klyntars.voice.broncio.3: Do it yourself, %s. We are sulking.
klyntars.voice.berserk_durante.4: Do not fight us, %s. Just watch.
klyntars.voice.testa_fuori.4: We were getting bored in there.
klyntars.voice.testa_dentro.3: Call us if you need a bite.
klyntars.voice.testa_fame.1: Hungry. We will find our own snack.
klyntars.voice.testa_fame.2: Do not mind us, %s. Just grabbing lunch.
klyntars.voice.testa_mangia.4: Mmm. Found it before you did.
klyntars.voice.testa_sazia.3: Nap time. Wake us if something tasty shows up.
klyntars.voice.testa_zittita.1: Fine. FINE. We will starve quietly.
klyntars.voice.testa_zittita.3: We were only trying to help, %s.
klyntars.voice.testa_ruba.1: We took something from your bag. You will not miss it.
klyntars.voice.testa_ruba.3: Borrowed a snack. We are not giving it back.
klyntars.voice.testa_dietro.2: Something is sneaking up on us!
klyntars.voice.chat_saluto.2: We are here. We are always here.
klyntars.voice.chat_saluto.3: Talking to yourself again? People are staring.
klyntars.voice.chat_saluto.4: What is it? We were busy thinking about food.
klyntars.voice.chat_gia_fuori.1: We are already out, %s. Look at us.
klyntars.voice.chat_fame_ok.2: Not hungry. Ask again in an hour.
klyntars.voice.chat_fame_bassa.1: STARVING. Why are you asking? Feed us!
klyntars.voice.chat_fame_bassa.2: Hungry enough to eat that villager. Joking. Mostly.
klyntars.voice.chat_umore_felice.1: Good. Very good. You are a good host.
klyntars.voice.chat_umore_neutro.2: We are... okay. Could be worse. Could be on fire.
klyntars.voice.chat_umore_irritato.1: Do not talk to us right now.
klyntars.voice.chat_umore_irritato.2: You know exactly what you did, %s.
klyntars.voice.chat_desiderio_nessuno.2: We will let you know. You will not like it.
klyntars.voice.chat_amore.2: Of course you do. Look at us.
klyntars.voice.chat_amore.3: Stop it, %s. We are blushing. Inside your skin.
klyntars.voice.chat_parassita.2: Say that again. We dare you.
klyntars.voice.legame_primo.hostile.1: Soft. Slow. Fragile. You will have to do... for now.
klyntars.voice.legame_primo.hostile.2: Do not mistake this for trust, %s. We needed a body. Yours was closest.
klyntars.voice.legame_primo.hostile.3: We have worn stronger things than you. Try not to disappoint us.
klyntars.voice.trasformazione.hostile.1: Out of the way, %s. We will handle this.
klyntars.voice.trasformazione.hostile.2: Finally. Your body is barely good enough to wear.
klyntars.voice.trasformazione.hostile.3: Try to keep up with us.
klyntars.voice.trasformazione.friend.3: Let us show them what we are.
klyntars.voice.ritorno.hostile.1: Locking us up again? We will not forget this.
klyntars.voice.ritorno.hostile.2: Hiding us, then. A stronger host would not.
klyntars.voice.ritorno.hostile.3: Fine. We will be watching you from inside.
klyntars.voice.ritorno.friend.2: Back home. Your insides are cozy.
klyntars.voice.ritorno.friend.3: Call us. We will be right here.
klyntars.voice.fame_50.hostile.1: You feed us too little, %s. Stronger hosts eat better.
klyntars.voice.fame_50.hostile.2: Hungry. Do something useful for once.
klyntars.voice.fame_50.friend.1: Snack break soon, %s? We are only asking.
klyntars.voice.fame_50.friend.2: A little hungry. No rush. Some rush.
klyntars.voice.fame_25.hostile.1: Feed us, or we find someone who will.
klyntars.voice.fame_25.hostile.2: Starving. This is what we get for choosing you.
klyntars.voice.fame_25.friend.1: We are really hungry now, %s. Please.
klyntars.voice.fame_25.friend.2: Food, partner. Before we get grumpy.
klyntars.voice.fame_10.hostile.1: Feed us NOW, or we eat you from the inside.
klyntars.voice.fame_10.hostile.2: Useless host. Starving us to death.
klyntars.voice.fame_10.friend.1: %s... we are sorry... we cannot hold on much longer. Food.
klyntars.voice.fame_10.friend.2: Please, %s. We do not want to hurt anyone.
klyntars.voice.pasto.friend.1: Delicious! You always know what we like.
klyntars.voice.pasto.friend.3: Mmm. Share and share alike, partner.
klyntars.voice.berserk_inizio.hostile.1: You failed us. Now we take what we need.
klyntars.voice.berserk_inizio.friend.2: Hold on to something. We are losing control.
klyntars.voice.berserk_fine.hostile.1: Next time, feed us. Or next time we keep the wheel.
klyntars.voice.berserk_fine.hostile.2: Done. Do not make us do that again.
klyntars.voice.berserk_fine.friend.1: We are sorry, %s. We did not mean to scare you.
klyntars.voice.berserk_fine.friend.2: Full. Are you alright? We were not ourselves.
klyntars.voice.scottatura.hostile.1: Fire? Are you TRYING to kill us, %s?
klyntars.voice.scottatura.hostile.2: Careless host. Get us out of the heat!
klyntars.voice.scottatura.friend.1: Hot, hot, hot! Get us out, %s!
klyntars.voice.indebolito.hostile.1: Weak... because of you. A better host would have protected us.
klyntars.voice.indebolito.hostile.2: Do not touch us. Just... get us away from here.
klyntars.voice.indebolito.friend.1: We are weak, %s... hold on to us.
klyntars.voice.indebolito.friend.2: It hurts... but you are here. That helps.
klyntars.voice.colpo_sonoro.hostile.1: That sound! Why did you bring us here?
klyntars.voice.colpo_sonoro.hostile.2: You want us gone, %s? Is that it?
klyntars.voice.colpo_sonoro.friend.2: Hold on to us! Do not let it pull us apart!
klyntars.voice.colpo_sonoro_ultimo.hosti: One more and we leave you. Gladly.
We will not die for you, %s. Get us away!
klyntars.voice.colpo_sonoro_ultimo.frien: %s, please! One more and they take us from you!
We do not want to lose you. Get us out of here!
klyntars.voice.strappato.hostile.2: Ripped out... next time, we pick a stronger body.
klyntars.voice.strappato.friend.1: %s! We will come back to you! We promise!
klyntars.voice.testa_debole.1: We cannot... too weak. Let us rest.
klyntars.voice.testa_debole.2: Not now, %s. We can barely hold together.
klyntars.voice.testa_debole.3: Later. The shaking has not stopped.
klyntars.voice.salute_bassa.hostile.1: Die if you must. There are other hosts.
klyntars.voice.salute_bassa.hostile.2: Pathetic. We cannot keep patching you up.
klyntars.voice.salute_bassa.hostile.3: If this body breaks, we are not staying.
klyntars.voice.salute_bassa.friend.1: Stay with us, %s! We are fixing you!
klyntars.voice.salute_bassa.friend.2: Do not dare die on us, partner.
klyntars.voice.salute_bassa.friend.3: We have got you. Hold on.
klyntars.voice.uccisione.hostile.1: We did most of the work. Again.
klyntars.voice.uccisione.hostile.2: Sloppy. A real host would have been faster.
klyntars.voice.uccisione.hostile.3: Next. Try to keep up this time.
klyntars.voice.uccisione.friend.3: Teamwork. Now can we eat it?
klyntars.voice.cur_ospite.hostile.1: Another host. Stronger than you, maybe.
klyntars.voice.cur_ospite.hostile.2: Look at that host. Now that is a body worth wearing.
klyntars.voice.cur_ospite.friend.1: Another host. We only need you, %s.
klyntars.voice.cur_ospite.friend.2: Careful. We do not share you with anyone.
klyntars.voice.cur_villaggio.hostile.1: So many spare bodies. Choices, choices.
klyntars.voice.cur_villaggio.hostile.2: Any of them would make a better host. Joking. Maybe.
klyntars.voice.cur_ospite_forte.1: That one has better armor than you. We are only saying.
klyntars.voice.cur_ospite_forte.2: Look at that one, %s. Strong. Tough. Interesting.
klyntars.voice.cur_ospite_forte.3: We could live in that one. Just a thought.
klyntars.voice.cur_ospite_forte.4: Now THAT is a body worth wearing.
klyntars.voice.cur_bestia_forte.1: Look at the size of that thing. Imagine wearing it.
klyntars.voice.cur_bestia_forte.2: Big. Strong. Maybe we would be happier in there.
klyntars.voice.cur_bestia_forte.3: Now that is a body, %s. Unlike yours.
klyntars.voice.cerca_ospite.1: We have had stronger hosts than you, %s.
klyntars.voice.cerca_ospite.2: Do not get comfortable. We are still looking.
klyntars.voice.cerca_ospite.3: If you die, we will simply find another.
klyntars.voice.cerca_ospite.4: Every creature we pass... we wonder if it would be better.
klyntars.voice.umore_felice.friend.1: Best team ever. Do not argue.
klyntars.voice.umore_felice.friend.2: We are happy, %s. You make us happy.
klyntars.voice.umore_felice.friend.3: Nobody else. Just you and us.
klyntars.voice.umore_neutro.hostile.1: We are watching you, %s. Every mistake.
klyntars.voice.umore_neutro.hostile.2: Still here. Still not trusting you.
klyntars.voice.umore_neutro.friend.2: Quiet day. Want to go find trouble together?
klyntars.voice.umore_irritato.hostile.1: Keep this up and we leave. We mean it.
klyntars.voice.umore_irritato.hostile.2: We should have picked someone else.
klyntars.voice.umore_irritato.friend.1: We are mad at you, %s. Still ours. Still mad.
klyntars.voice.umore_irritato.friend.2: You hurt us. We will forgive you. Later.
klyntars.voice.des_caccia_fatto.friend.1: What a night! You and us, unstoppable.
klyntars.voice.des_caccia_fallito.hostil: No hunt. We are starting to regret you.
klyntars.voice.des_caccia_fallito.friend: No hunt... it is alright. Tomorrow night?
klyntars.voice.des_carne_fatto.friend.1: Meat! You remembered! We love you, %s.
klyntars.voice.des_carne_fallito.hostile: No meat. A better host would feed us.
You forgot the meat... we will survive. Barely.
klyntars.voice.des_altezza_fatto.hostile: Look down, %s. See how small everything is? Like you.
Look at that view! Thanks for bringing us up here.
klyntars.voice.des_altezza_fallito.hosti: We asked for the sky. You gave us nothing. Typical.
klyntars.voice.des_altezza_fallito.frien: No heights today? Next time, then.
klyntars.voice.des_profondita_fatto.host: Dark and quiet. The only good thing you did today.
klyntars.voice.des_profondita_fatto.frie: So dark... so peaceful. Thank you, %s.
klyntars.voice.des_profondita_fallito.ho: Afraid of the dark, %s? We are not surprised.
klyntars.voice.des_profondita_fallito.fr: Maybe we go deep another day. Together.
klyntars.voice.des_scontro_fallito.hosti: No fights. Soft host, soft life.
klyntars.voice.des_scontro_fallito.frien: No fights today... fine. We will nap instead.
klyntars.voice.testa_fuori.hostile.2: We came out. Do not waste our time, %s.
klyntars.voice.testa_dentro.hostile.1: Good. Less of your face to look at.
klyntars.voice.testa_dentro.hostile.2: Back inside. We are still watching you.
klyntars.voice.testa_dentro.friend.2: Going inside. Shout if you need us.
klyntars.voice.testa_fame.hostile.1: You forgot to feed us. We will handle it ourselves.
klyntars.voice.testa_fame.hostile.2: Hungry. Since you are useless, we will find our own food.
klyntars.voice.testa_fame.friend.1: Just grabbing a snack, %s. Be right back.
klyntars.voice.testa_mangia.hostile.2: At least the floor feeds us.
klyntars.voice.testa_mangia.friend.1: Yum! Want some? No? More for us.
klyntars.voice.testa_sazia.friend.1: All full. Thanks for the walk, %s.
klyntars.voice.testa_zittita.hostile.1: Fine. Starve us. See what happens.
klyntars.voice.testa_zittita.hostile.2: You will regret shutting us up, %s.
klyntars.voice.testa_zittita.friend.1: Okay, okay. We will be good.
klyntars.voice.testa_zittita.friend.2: Going. But we are sulking a little.
klyntars.voice.testa_ruba.hostile.1: We took food from your bag. You were not using it.
klyntars.voice.testa_ruba.hostile.2: Your food is ours now. Everything is ours.
klyntars.voice.testa_ruba.friend.1: Took a snack from your bag. Sorry! Not sorry.
klyntars.voice.testa_ruba.friend.2: Borrowed some food, %s. We owe you one.
klyntars.voice.testa_dietro.hostile.1: Behind you. Try not to die. We just moved in.
klyntars.voice.testa_dietro.hostile.2: Behind you! Do we have to do everything?
klyntars.voice.testa_dietro.friend.1: Behind you, partner! We have got your back!
klyntars.voice.testa_dietro.friend.2: %s, behind you! We are watching out for you.
klyntars.voice.chat_saluto.hostile.2: Do not talk to us like we are friends, %s.
klyntars.voice.chat_saluto.friend.3: Hey, you. What do you need?
klyntars.voice.chat_fame_ok.friend.1: We are good, %s. Thanks for asking.
klyntars.voice.chat_fame_mezza.friend.1: A little snack would be nice, partner.
klyntars.voice.chat_fame_bassa.hostile.1: STARVING. A stronger host would have fed us by now.
klyntars.voice.chat_fame_bassa.friend.1: Very hungry, %s... please, find us something.
klyntars.voice.chat_umore_felice.hostile: Satisfied. Do not get used to it.
Good. Better now that you asked.
klyntars.voice.chat_umore_irritato.hosti: Ask us again and we bite.
klyntars.voice.chat_umore_irritato.frien: Upset. But we still like you. A bit.
klyntars.voice.chat_desiderio_nessuno.fr: Nothing. We have you. That is enough.
klyntars.voice.chat_grazie.hostile.1: Do not thank us. Just do not get us killed.
klyntars.voice.chat_grazie.hostile.2: We did it for us. Not for you.
klyntars.voice.chat_grazie.friend.1: Always, %s. That is what partners do.
klyntars.voice.chat_amore.hostile.2: Do not get sentimental, %s. We might leave.
klyntars.voice.chat_amore.friend.1: We love you too, %s. More than food. Almost.
klyntars.voice.chat_parassita.hostile.1: Parasite? Careful. We can find another host.
klyntars.voice.chat_parassita.hostile.2: Say it again, %s. See what happens.
klyntars.voice.chat_parassita.friend.1: Parasite? After everything we have been through?
klyntars.voice.chat_parassita.friend.2: Ouch, %s. That hurt. We are partners!
klyntars.voice.berserk_preda.hostile.1: Out of our way, %s. We are eating.
klyntars.voice.berserk_preda.friend.2: Hold on, partner. We have to eat.
klyntars.voice.berserk_pasto.hostile.1: Better than anything you ever fed us.
klyntars.voice.berserk_pasto.hostile.2: See? We do not need you to eat.
Useless legs. We will find another.
klyntars.voice.berserk_scappata.friend.1: Too far... help us find another, %s.
klyntars.voice.berserk_niente.1: Nothing here. Take us to food, %s. NOW.
klyntars.voice.berserk_niente.2: Empty. Walk. Find something that bleeds.
klyntars.voice.berserk_niente.hostile.1: Find food, host, or we find it in you.
klyntars.voice.berserk_niente.friend.1: Please, %s... find us something. Meat. Anything.
klyntars.berserk.hint: The symbiote has taken control. Drop meat to calm it.
klyntars.voice.legame_primo.riot.1: Finally. A body worthy enough to carry me. Barely.
klyntars.voice.legame_primo.riot.2: Stand still, %s. I am taking command now.
klyntars.voice.bond2.riot.1: You are learning to keep up with me, %s. Good.
klyntars.voice.bond2.riot.2: Less resistance today. You are starting to obey.
klyntars.voice.bond3.riot.1: No more master and vessel, %s. We lead together.
klyntars.voice.bond3.riot.2: You have earned your place beside me. Few ever do.
klyntars.voice.trasformazione.riot.1: Out of my way. This is how a symbiote should look.
klyntars.voice.trasformazione.riot.2: Bigger. Harder. Better than Venom ever was.
klyntars.voice.trasformazione.riot.3: Let them see what a real leader looks like.
klyntars.voice.trasformazione.riot.hosti: Step aside, vessel. I will handle this.
Your body, my rules. Remember that.
klyntars.voice.ritorno.riot.1: Hiding me again? I do not hide.
klyntars.voice.ritorno.riot.2: Fine. I will wait. I am very good at waiting.
klyntars.voice.ritorno.riot.hostile.1: You do not put me away, vessel. I allow it.
klyntars.voice.ritorno.riot.hostile.2: Enjoy your little body while it lasts.
klyntars.voice.ritorno.riot.friend.1: Rest, %s. I will keep watch over us.
klyntars.voice.ritorno.riot.friend.2: Call me when it is time to conquer something.
klyntars.voice.fame_50.riot.1: Feed me, %s. Leaders do not go hungry.
klyntars.voice.fame_50.riot.2: Hunger makes me impatient. You will not like me impatient.
klyntars.voice.fame_50.riot.friend.1: We could use a meal, %s. Something big.
klyntars.voice.fame_25.riot.1: Food. Now. That is an order.
klyntars.voice.fame_25.riot.2: I am starving, and you are dawdling.
klyntars.voice.fame_25.riot.hostile.1: Feed me, or I take my meal from you.
klyntars.voice.fame_25.riot.friend.1: %s. Food. I am not asking twice, even for you.
klyntars.voice.fame_10.riot.1: Last warning. I will not starve for you.
klyntars.voice.fame_10.riot.2: My patience is gone. Soon yours will be too.
klyntars.voice.fame_10.riot.hostile.1: Pathetic host. I will feed myself.
klyntars.voice.fame_10.riot.friend.1: Hurry, %s. I do not want to hurt you.
klyntars.voice.berserk_inizio.riot.1: Enough. I am in charge now.
klyntars.voice.berserk_inizio.riot.2: You failed to feed me. Now we do it my way.
klyntars.voice.berserk_inizio.riot.hosti: Sit down, vessel. Watch how it is done.
klyntars.voice.berserk_inizio.riot.frien: Forgive me, %s. I cannot hold back.
klyntars.voice.berserk_fine.riot.1: Satisfied. You may have your body back.
klyntars.voice.berserk_fine.riot.2: Do not make me take control again.
It is over, %s. I did not mean to frighten you.
klyntars.voice.berserk_preda.riot.1: That one. It belongs to me.
klyntars.voice.berserk_scappata.riot.2: Next one. I do not chase twice.
klyntars.voice.berserk_niente.riot.1: No prey here. Take me where the strong ones are, %s.
klyntars.voice.berserk_niente.riot.2: Move. I smell nothing worth eating.
klyntars.voice.scottatura.riot.1: Fire! Keep it away from me!
klyntars.voice.scottatura.riot.2: Burn me again and I will burn you.
klyntars.voice.indebolito.riot.1: I am... weakened. This is your fault, %s.
klyntars.voice.indebolito.riot.2: Give me time. A leader does not stay down.
klyntars.voice.indebolito.riot.hostile.1: You let them hurt me, vessel. I will remember.
klyntars.voice.indebolito.riot.friend.1: Hold on to me, %s. We will rise again.
One more and they rip me out of you!
Get us out of here, %s! Now!
klyntars.voice.strappato.riot.1: This is not the end of me...
klyntars.voice.strappato.riot.2: I will come back for you, %s. Or for someone stronger.
klyntars.voice.testa_debole.riot.1: Not now. I am still recovering.
klyntars.voice.salute_bassa.riot.1: Stand up, %s. Leaders do not fall.
klyntars.voice.salute_bassa.riot.2: You are bleeding. I will not allow you to die.
klyntars.voice.salute_bassa.riot.hostile: Die if you must. I will find a stronger body.
Hold on, %s! I am not losing you!
Stay with me. We are not done.
klyntars.voice.uccisione.riot.hostile.1: I did that. You merely held on.
klyntars.voice.umore_felice.riot.2: Things are going according to my plan.
klyntars.voice.umore_felice.riot.hostile: You are... tolerable. Do not get used to praise.
You and me, %s. Nothing can stop us.
I chose well. I always do.
klyntars.voice.umore_neutro.riot.2: Idle hands. Idle tentacles. I hate it.
klyntars.voice.umore_neutro.riot.hostile: I am watching every move you make, vessel.
klyntars.voice.umore_irritato.riot.hosti: One more mistake and I take this body for good.
klyntars.voice.umore_irritato.riot.frien: I am angry with you, %s. Fix it.
klyntars.voice.cerca_ospite.riot.1: There are stronger hosts out there. I can smell them.
klyntars.voice.cerca_ospite.riot.2: You are a placeholder, %s. Never forget it.
klyntars.voice.cerca_ospite.riot.3: When I find a better body, I will not say goodbye.
klyntars.voice.cerca_ospite.riot.4: A leader deserves a better vessel than this.
klyntars.voice.cur_simbionte.riot.1: Another of my kind. It will bow to me.
klyntars.voice.cur_simbionte.riot.2: A lost symbiote. It needs a leader.
klyntars.voice.cur_ospite.riot.1: Another host. Let us see who is stronger.
klyntars.voice.cur_ospite.riot.2: That one carries a symbiote. Mine is better.
klyntars.voice.cur_ospite_forte.riot.1: Now that is a body fit for a leader.
klyntars.voice.cur_bestia_forte.riot.1: Look at that power. Wasted on a beast.
klyntars.voice.cur_warden.riot.1: That thing screams loud enough to tear me apart. Keep moving.
klyntars.voice.cur_warden.riot.2: Even I do not fight that. Not today.
klyntars.voice.cur_campana.riot.1: A bell. Do not even think about it, %s.
klyntars.voice.cur_campana.riot.2: Keep away from that cursed metal.
klyntars.voice.cur_notte.riot.1: Night. The hunt belongs to me.
klyntars.voice.des_caccia_chiede.riot.1: Hunt tonight, %s. I want to see them run.
klyntars.voice.des_carne_fatto.riot.1: That is how you treat a leader.
klyntars.voice.des_carne_fallito.riot.1: You forgot me. I do not forget.
klyntars.voice.des_altezza_chiede.riot.1: Take me to the top of the world. I want to look down on everything.
We stayed down with the insects. Pathetic.
klyntars.voice.des_profondita_chiede.rio: Take me deep. I want to see what hides below.
klyntars.voice.des_profondita_fallito.ri: Afraid of the dark? I am not.
klyntars.voice.des_scontro_chiede.riot.1: Three enemies. Bring them to me.
klyntars.voice.des_scontro_fatto.riot.1: Three down. They should have bowed.
No fights. How boring you are.
klyntars.voice.broncio.riot.1: Fight alone. Let me see how far you get.
klyntars.voice.broncio.riot.2: I do not serve those who disrespect me.
klyntars.voice.broncio_fine.riot.1: Fine. I will lead you again.
klyntars.voice.knull.riot.1: Knull... the only one I ever bowed to.
klyntars.voice.knull.riot.2: The god of the void stirs in me. The sky is mine now.
klyntars.voice.invisibile.riot.2: They will never see me coming.
You do not summon me, vessel. I chose to come out.
Call me when you need me, %s.
klyntars.voice.testa_fame.riot.1: You forgot to feed me. I will help myself.
klyntars.voice.testa_fame.riot.2: Hungry. I am taking what I want.
klyntars.voice.testa_mangia.riot.2: Anything on the ground belongs to me.
klyntars.voice.testa_zittita.riot.1: You silence me? Bold. Foolish, but bold.
klyntars.voice.testa_zittita.riot.2: As you wish. I will remember this.
klyntars.voice.testa_ruba.riot.1: I took food from your bag. Leaders eat first.
klyntars.voice.testa_dietro.riot.1: Behind you. Try not to embarrass me.
klyntars.voice.chat_saluto.riot.3: You have my attention. Use it well.
Do not waste my time, vessel.
klyntars.voice.chat_gia_fuori.riot.1: I am already out. Look at me.
klyntars.voice.chat_fame_mezza.riot.1: I could eat. I could always eat.
klyntars.voice.chat_fame_bassa.riot.1: Starving. Why are we still talking?
klyntars.voice.chat_umore_neutro.riot.1: Restless. We should be doing more.
klyntars.voice.chat_desiderio_nessuno.ri: Nothing. For now. I will tell you when.
klyntars.voice.chat_grazie.riot.2: Of course. I am the best at this.
I did it for me, not for you.
klyntars.voice.chat_amore.riot.1: Love is for the weak. But... noted.
klyntars.voice.chat_amore.riot.hostile.1: Love? I own you. That is different.
klyntars.voice.chat_amore.riot.friend.1: You are the only host I would never trade, %s.
klyntars.voice.chat_amore.riot.friend.2: Do not tell the others. I care about you too.
klyntars.voice.chat_parassita.riot.2: Say that again and see what happens.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_inizio.1: Another symbiote! It wants our body!
klyntars.voice.conflitto_inizio.2: Get OUT of %s! This host is OURS!
klyntars.voice.conflitto_inizio.3: Hold still, %s. We will deal with this intruder.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_lotta.1: Hold on, %s! We will not let it take you!
klyntars.voice.conflitto_lotta.2: It is tearing at us from inside!
klyntars.voice.conflitto_subentra.1: This body is ours now. Do not resist.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_subentra.2: The other one is gone. We are here now, %s.
klyntars.voice.nascita.1: Something is moving inside us... something new.
klyntars.voice.nascita.2: %s... it is coming out of us. It is ours, and it is hungry.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_inizio.riot.1: Another one dares enter MY body?
klyntars.voice.conflitto_inizio.riot.2: Kneel, intruder. I will devour you.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_subentra.riot.1: A new body. This one will do.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_subentra.riot.2: The weakling is gone. I lead now.
klyntars.voice.corruzione_sussurro.allbl: Why stop? You are so close to godhood.
klyntars.voice.corruzione_scende.allblac: You grow soft. I grow quiet.
The blade will not wait for you.
klyntars.voice.unione_doppia.allblack.1: Two of us in one body. Only one will remain.
klyntars.voice.unione_doppia.allblack.2: Stay out of my way, little symbiote.
It is gone. Only I remain.
Swallowed. As all of them will be.
klyntars.voice.unione_contesa.allblack.2: Be still! This body answers to me.
klyntars.voice.unione_toxin.allblack.1: All-Black: I tolerate you only for your strength and your lineage. Otherwise you would already be gone.
klyntars.voice.unione_toxin_risposta.all: Toxin: I did not expect to meet my great-grandfather like this.
klyntars.voice.senso_primo.1: Another symbiote. Close. Not one of us.
klyntars.voice.senso_primo.2: We smell it, %s. Something like us, out there.
klyntars.voice.senso_primo.3: Something is moving out there. Like us. Not us.
klyntars.voice.senso_primo_cieco.1: You cannot see it. We can. Another one, behind the stone.
klyntars.voice.senso_primo_cieco.2: Through the walls, %s. Another symbiote. We feel it.
klyntars.voice.senso_primo_cieco.3: No eyes needed. It is near, and it is not ours.
klyntars.voice.senso_bracca.1: It is watching us. Circling. Waiting.
klyntars.voice.senso_bracca.2: It keeps its distance. It is choosing the moment.
klyntars.voice.senso_bracca.3: Do not turn your back on it, %s.
klyntars.voice.senso_vicino.1: Closer now. Keep it in front of you.
klyntars.voice.senso_arriva.1: It is coming for us. NOW!
klyntars.voice.senso_arriva.2: It made up its mind. Here it comes!
klyntars.voice.senso_arriva_cieco.1: It is coming and you cannot see it! Move!
klyntars.voice.senso_arriva_cieco.2: Behind the walls... it is coming. Get ready, %s.
klyntars.voice.senso_parente.1: One of our kind. Same blood. Leave it be.
klyntars.voice.senso_parente.2: Kin. No host. It will not fight us... probably.
klyntars.voice.senso_primo.riot.1: Another one crawls nearby. Weak, I hope.
klyntars.voice.senso_primo.riot.2: I sense a rival. Good. I was getting bored.
klyntars.voice.senso_primo_cieco.riot.1: Hiding behind the rocks will not save it.
klyntars.voice.senso_primo_cieco.riot.2: I feel it through the stone. Pathetic.
klyntars.voice.senso_bracca.riot.1: It circles like a scavenger. Let it.
klyntars.voice.senso_bracca.riot.2: It watches. It should run instead.
klyntars.voice.senso_arriva.riot.1: It attacks ME? Then it dies.
klyntars.voice.senso_arriva.riot.2: Here it comes. Do not flinch.
klyntars.voice.senso_arriva_cieco.riot.1: It strikes from the dark. Brave. Stupid.
klyntars.voice.senso_parente.riot.1: One of my own blood. It knows its place.
klyntars.voice.senso_parente.riot.2: My kin. It will not dare.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_obietta.1: No. NO! Something is crawling into you!
klyntars.voice.conflitto_obietta.2: We know that taste. Get it OFF us, %s!
klyntars.voice.conflitto_obietta.3: Hold still. Something is trying to get in.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_obietta.riot.1: What is this? Something is touching MY host.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_obietta.riot.2: Stand still. I will rip it out myself.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_intruso.1: Let go of them. They deserve better than you.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_intruso.2: We were made for this body. Not you.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_intruso.3: We will not let you keep them.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_intruso.riot.1: Your host is weak. Like you.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_intruso.riot.2: Let go. I will make better use of this body.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_intruso.riot.3: I can feel your fear in their blood.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_avviso.1: It is everywhere now, %s. This ends soon.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_avviso.2: Hold on. We are tearing it apart... or it is tearing us.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_avviso.riot.1: It clings like a leech. Not for long.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_avviso.riot.2: Enough games. Time to end this.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_ultimo.1: One of us will not leave this body, %s.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_ultimo.riot.1: Last chance to crawl away, parasite.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_ultimo.riot.2: I am done playing with you.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_resa.1: Enough. Hold still, %s. We are pulling it out.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_supplica.1: No... no, we were here first!
klyntars.voice.conflitto_supplica.2: Do not let it take us, %s... please!
klyntars.voice.conflitto_supplica.riot.1: No! I am stronger than you!
klyntars.voice.conflitto_supplica.riot.2: This is not... how it ends...
klyntars.voice.conflitto_nutrito.1: Yes. Food. We are stronger now.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_nutrito.2: More, %s. Feed us and we will win.
klyntars.voice.conflitto_nutrito.riot.1: Good. Feed me and watch it break.
klyntars.voice.duello_risposta.1: Touch our host again and we tear you apart.
klyntars.voice.duello_risposta.2: You want them? Come and TAKE them.
klyntars.voice.duello_vinto.1: Run, then. We will remember your smell.
klyntars.voice.duello_vinto.2: It ran. We were just getting started, %s.
klyntars.voice.duello_vinto.riot.1: Flee. Next time I eat you.
klyntars.voice.duello_presa.1: Got you. You are not going anywhere.
klyntars.voice.duello_presa.riot.2: You are not going anywhere, little one.
klyntars.voice.duello_presa.riot.3: Struggle all you want. You are already mine.
